mods.name: Mega Cobble
mods.description: Adds Mega Evolution to Cobblemon: real in-battle transformations through the bundled Showdown sim, out-of-battle world megas, and a data-driven pipeline for custom megas.

releases.notes:
- **Stoneless Mega Rayquaza (in-battle + overworld).** Rayquaza Mega Evolves with **no Mega Stone** — it just needs to know **Dragon Ascent** and carry a **Key Stone**, the authentic way.
- **In battle:** the mod feeds Showdown an invisible "Rayquazite" for a Dragon-Ascent Rayquaza (nothing the player ever holds or sees).
- **Out of battle:** `/megacobble worldmega` allows it via a move-gated stoneless exception (still refuses other stoneless mons).
- Model falls back to the substitute doll and it's renamed **Mega-Rayquaza**.

mods.name: Mega Cobble
mods.description: Adds Mega Evolution to Cobblemon: real in-battle transformations through the bundled Showdown sim, out-of-battle world megas, and a data-driven pipeline for custom megas.

releases.notes:
- **Z-Moves:** all **35 Z-Crystals** (18 type + 17 signature) + a **Z-Ring**, shipped like the Mega Stones (server-side vanilla items). Get them with `/megacobble give <crystal>`.
- **Mega Zygarde:** the base-game Legends Z-A mega Champions omitted — Dragon/Ground, gated to the **Complete Forme**. Roster now **45 megas / 92 stones**.
- **`/megacobble damage [on|off]`:** a per-player, all-access in-battle damage readout that reads the sim's real HP.

releases.notes:
**First stable release.**

- Full **44-mega Z-A + Champions/DLC roster** with **91 Mega Stones**.
- In-battle Showdown megas (correct stats / typing / abilities, name synced to the HUD).
- Out-of-battle **"world" Mega Evolution** via the interaction wheel + `/megacobble worldmega` (with riding).
- Per-mega custom models (Mega Venusaur), the Key Stone gate, and the v0.0.9 server-side fixes.
